notes.title: Full Release - Major Changes and Added Features
notes.notes:
[p][b]Plantasia Full Release: Bedroom Decor, Seed Shuffler, Store and Database, and Gene Traits[/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]Hey there! Thank you for playing our cozy game! The release of Plantasia 1.0 is a moment filled with emotion and gratitude to both our mentors and all of you, the people who made this game happen. It’s extremely rewarding to see what we have achieved as an all-volunteer team for our first released game.[/p][p]
The Full Release includes several new and exciting features: decorate your bedroom, buy and shuffle seeds, have an overview of your seed database, along with several improvements to the existing version.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the full release notes below![/p][p]
[/p][h2]Full Release Overview[/h2][list][*][p]Decorate your bedroom with craftable decor available in 4 color schemes[/p][/*][*][p]Discover new seeds using the Seed Shuffler[/p][/*][*][p]Purchase more of the already discovered seeds in the Seed Store[/p][/*][*][p]Keep track of your discovered plant families, species, and colors in the Seed Database[/p][/*][*][p]Grow plants faster with newly added Affixes - gene traits that are more frequently encountered during the growth phase[/p][/*][*][p]Discover new Quests to get used to the game’s mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Filter and sort through your Inventory for easier seed selection[/p][/*][*][p]And more improvements to already existing features[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]MAC BUILD COMING VERY SOON[/p][p]Full Soundtrack now available for purchase through Steam![/p][p]
[/p][h1][u][b]ALERT:[/b][/u][/h1][p]
It is highly recommended that all players clear their existing Save Data after updating the game to 1.0. If you choose to not clear your Save Data you may experience bugs the developers did not intend. We understand that you may have put a lot of hours and work into the game and may not want to delete that progress, but we strongly believe your experience will be much improved by starting fresh. We are unlikely to be able to fix bugs that occur due to uncleared data.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]Decorate Your Bedroom[/h2][p]A new room has been added to the Greenhouse! Relax in style in your new and completely customizable Bedroom.[/p][p]Unlock decor in your bedroom by crafting. Use the resources you collect while growing plants and create a cozy bedroom in different color schemes.[/p][p]Decor can be crafted using the Crafting Table. Each crafting recipe shows what kind of resources you still need and what you have in your inventory. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/ec2176187d68942c3b575f38991754a2ee8603b0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/0b45422e9a043711e8b3fd18592036d4f512908d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Seed Bank: Complete your Seed Database[/h2][p]The Seed Bank is now open for use! One of the functionalities you can use with this addition is the Seed Database. Here, you can see which plants you have discovered, which plants are unknown, and details about the plant species and gene traits.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/4ccf69de2ae7ba83d90c9107a755ff2da29e5514.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/88652dc4ec179c789701219774908821dee4ab15.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Seed Bank: Purchase Seeds in the Seed Store[/h2][p]The second tab in the Seed Bank is a Seed Store. Use the newly added currency to buy seeds of a specific species that you have already unlocked. Undiscovered seeds aren’t available for purchase.[/p][p][/p][h2]Seed Bank: The Seed Shuffler[/h2][p]The seed shuffler is a scientific device that shuffles seed DNA to create new types of seeds. Use in game currency to power the device and if you are lucky you may unlock never before discovered seeds. The shuffler is also great for discovering new or improved Gene Traits.[/p][p][/p][h2]Gene Traits[/h2][p]Plants now have Gene Traits – traits that change many aspects of the seeds growth, output or needs. You can view all Gene Traits in the Seed Database. Cross-breeding plants will also take Gene Traits into account. Gene Traits are a high level mechanic, and intended for players who want to deeply customize their growing experience. Casual players do not need to interact with this system in order to achieve their goals.[/p][p][/p][h2]Revamped Tutorials [/h2][p]Almost all tutorials have been reworked and put into an all-new quest format. Come along as B.E.A.R. teaches you the ins and outs of GARDEN Station systems with the help of the other REVIVE representatives. All Quests are “play at your own pace” and must be triggered by the player. This allows players to move through the story as slowly or quickly as they would like.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/505e5e74711d92853fc435e8e0d93a561b70ddd0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/139454bb438353b7a58bc0d7f2eacc062f53d47f.png"][/img][/p][h2]Filter and Sort Seeds in Your Inventory[/h2][p]Looking for specific plants to grow? Use the newly added filters and sorting options! Sorting allows you to see seeds you currently own based on when they were discovered, alphabetically, by gene traits, tiers, colors and types. Multiple filters can be selected for a plant’s base, bloom, color or gene trait. Once you have selected all your desired traits, apply your selection and click on the window title again to close it.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/2662c66d6612aaa2e375f5a4407cf55710c96a30.png"][/img][/p][h2]Complete Requests and Earn Resources[/h2][p]Requests from REVIVE have been moved to the top right corner. Click on the clipboard icon to see your active requests, then click on the request you’d like to complete and select the seeds you wish. Now that the Seed Store exists, Requests will no longer award seeds upon completion.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292466/12ab0403ebd8ff335ac53d661c93791871eb53fe.png"][/img][/p][h2]On the future of Plantasia[/h2][p]First and foremost, Cave Bear Games is an all-volunteer studio by and for juniors looking to break into the game dev industry (and some of us now have!).
[/p][h3]But what does that have to do with Plantasia?[/h3][p]Well, it means that a lot of the team will be focused on following the studio’s main goal: providing a space for junior devs and designers to flex their muscles and hone their craft. Plantasia is, for all purposes, a complete and released game now.[/p][p][/p][h3]Does that mean Plantasia won’t receive any more updates?[/h3][p]Not necessarily. However, due to the nature of volunteer projects, any following updates will likely be minor bug fixes from the members who have the time to do so.[/p][p][/p][p]We want to thank everyone who supported us and believed in us throughout Plantasia’s development, and all the people who made this possible. A big thank you as well to all the mentors who were by our team's side and all our playtesters who made the game better. [/p][p][/p][p]And finally, a thank you to you for playing our game and giving us a chance. We hope that this game helps you escape the chaos of daily life and provides a cozy respite, if only for a moment.[/p][p]
[/p][p]- The Cave Bear Team[/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes #2 - 0.8.9.2
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest is at an end - but Plantasia is only beginning! We have received lots of community feedback about bugs, questions, and new features. We are committed to improving the Demo alongside the full game throughout development, and the Demo will remain live permanently.

Plantasia goes into Early Access in late March - so stay tuned!

[list]
[*] options menu anchor fixed
[*] Seed Bundle Request menu should work more smoothly
[*] Seed Bundle Requests no longer require specific plant colors without telling us
[*] Seed Colors are now present in the Seed Bundle Allocation menu
[*] Seed Bundle Alocation menus now close automatically when opening another Allocation menu
[*] Fixed MacKenna's dialogue after completing the first Seed Bundle Request
[*] Made good progress on stopping the Request Menu from crashing out when you complete one (not done yet but much closer)
[*] Removed console box that popped up in background for some machines
[*] Removed dev log that popped after planting seeds
[/list]

We are still working on a number of improvements daily! If you encounter bugs or have general feedback, please join our Discord and post your suggestions in the #community-feedback channel. Our developers are very active and can update you on upcoming changes.

Please join us this afternoon our Discord for a short Livestream with our Creative Director, Ayla to go over the newest updates. 3pm PST, March 3rd!

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes #1 - 0.8.9.1
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Plantasia during the first three days of Steam Next Fest! We have received lots of community feedback about bugs, questions, and new features. We are committed to improving the Demo alongside the full game throughout development - but certainly during Next Fest. 


New Features:
[list]
[*] Made seed bank spin on loop in the seed bank
[*] Added particle effect around plants when ready to harvest
[/list]

What has been fixed?
[list]
[*] Fixed scaling issues appearing on screens other than 1920x1080. All screens, including ultra wides, should fit Plantasia normally.
[*] Fixed an issue where seed in the inventory appeared outside the inventory box after scrolling
[*] Reduced the number of times a plant will generate a Growth Trigger 
[*] fixed an issue where plants in pots were not saved when closing and reopening Plantasia
[*] Max inventory count is now removed
[*] Fixed sub filtering on greenhouse and seed request inventories
[*] Redid seed bank room completely to work with the widescreen change
[*] Seed Bundle Request system refresh fixes and changes
[*] Plants planted in a planter not loading from save images fixed (new plants only)
[*] Multiple minor Adjustments to request bundle (grid layout, autoselect/deselect)
[*] No more spamming rewards from the Seed Bundle Requests
[*] Patched bug where inventory UI wasn't updating when a request was completed
[*] UI adjustments to NPC Dialogue (response highlighted buttons brightened)
[/list]

We are still working on a number of improvements daily! If you encounter bugs or have general feedback, please join our Discord and post your suggestions in the #community-feedback channel. Our developers are very active and can update you on upcoming changes.

Please join us tonight on the Steam Page or in our Discord for a Live Birthday Stream with our Creative Director, Ayla at 6pm PST, February 26th!

notes.title: Plantasia Demo Now Available
notes.notes:
From February 24th through March 3rd, a demo version of Plantasia will be available to play for free on Steam!

It has been 10 long months of development. We started as a tiny group of 3 friends and have grown to a fully functioning team of 16 junior developers. We are all very excited to share this amazing passion project with the public!

This demo showcases a full game loop of planting, tending, growing, harvesting, and breeding unique, houseplant-inspired, flora.

You begin with 2 different seeds and 6 open pots to grow them. Throughout the demo you will experience:

- 3 NPCs
- various Seed Bundle requests and rewards
- an introduction to the overall story
- a full 26 song original soundtrack
- the Greenhouse and Crafting rooms
- 6 base seeds
- numerous unique hybrid combinations
- 1 crafting recipe

Our full game will have MUCH more to discover!

Plantasia is still in active development, but we can promise you will be able to experience more of Plantasia, outside this demo, soon. 

In order to make the best game possible - we need your help! As you play Plantasia’s demo you may notice that somethings aren’t working how you expect, or wishing for a feature that does not exist. We plead you to share these thoughts with us - the team!

Feedback is extremely important for game developers to understand how you, the player, feel about the game and how you would like to see it improve. You can share your feedback with us directly, through our [url=https://discord.gg/e7meFZrBUn]Discord Server[/url] in the #community-feedback channel.

You can find us on nearly all other socials through our [url=https://linktr.ee/cavebeargames]Linktree[/url].

Thank you for participating in our demo! We cannot wait to share more with you.

The Cave Bear Games Team
